name: Misa
message: 「It's nighttime, so it can't be helped」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmph. I'm not scared at all. It's simply dark」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you not to worry, I was fine during today's special training too, right?」
Still, why do I have this vague uneasy feeling?

name: Ria
message: 「The way you say that makes it sound like you saw it yourself, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, n-no, that's not it. I just heard it was around this area」

name: Misa
message: 「Where and who did you even get this information from in the first place?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't tell me, Sakura-kun. You weren't out patrolling all by yourself, were you?」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, right! Prez used to be a delinquent, after all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「! Wait, don't tell me that's why you looked weirdly sleepy the other day--」

name: Melilot
message: 「It isn't very admirable for the Student Council to take the lead in breaking academy rules」

name: Melilot
message: 「The Chairman should have told you to stop patrolling」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-But we can't do that. This is an emergency.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go home. I will report this to the Chairwoman.」
I stepped forward as if to shield everyone.
Does this person have something to do with Azel's disappearance?
If she does, maybe I should confront her directly.

name: Melilot
message: 「And what does that have to do with you all being here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Someone spotted Azel around here right before she disappeared.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel was investigating something. And when she saw what she was looking into, she muttered, 'It's destroyed... Is it the enemy?'」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey! I didn't hear anything about that!」

name: Melilot
message: 「......I see. So the Bylous is imitating the Demon Lord's methods, is that it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go home. There is no need to look for Azel.」
For a brief moment, Ms. Melilot looked at Lolotte.

name: Lolotte
message: 「G-Glaring at me won't make me leave! Whether my friend gets reformed or not is riding on this!」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, I will make you leave by force if I must.」
They glowed a crimson red, like rubies trapping flames within.

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister! Sally! What is the meaning of this!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Glowing red eyes... No way... Then the ones in my dream were...」
A magical presence begins to spread outward, centered around Miss Melilot.
Judging by its density, her strength is only slightly above Pasta's.
She's surprisingly not that big of a deal. It's a bit of a letdown.
It doesn't come anywhere close to the sheer scale and depth of the presences I felt from Bylous and Soltia that day.
Still, she has acceleration magic. I can't let my guard down.

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn. She's leaking her magical power on purpose.」
Right, she was supposed to have complete control over her magic. Then why do something that exposes her true identity.

name: Ria
message: 「Miss Melilot! Weren't you Big Sister's friend!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A betrayal right here!? The guidebook said this kind of twist is most effective near the finale!」
Is she showing us that she's a Demon General just to force us to fight?

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura! Nanaka! What are you spacing out for!」

name: Synn
message: 「Guide thy master, descending by the ancient covenant, Avanshell, Angel of Pitch-Black Darkness!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm fine! I'll be fine! There's no way I'm the only one who can't do it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't see myself losing! Defeat is all that awaits a traitor!」
